character.name: Rosa Delgado
character.objective: I want to force my son to reverse the plant closure decision by using the exact leverage strategies I taught him.
character.super_objective: I want to protect the dignity and survival of my community so that my life's labor was not in vain.
character.voice_notes: She speaks in a low, resonant register with deliberate cadence, using silence as a weapon to force others to fill the room. Her speech pattern is direct and unembellished, dropping tempo to emphasize key demands like a lawyer laying down evidence.
character.physicality_notes: She stands with a heavy, rooted center and broad, squared shoulders that resist the natural weariness in her spine. Her hand gestures are spare and decisive—table-taps and pointed index fingers—never wasting energy on broad panic.
obstacles: Her son holds the legal corporate authority and final sign-off power over the shutdown.
Her maternal love for her son constantly pulls against her rage at his betrayal.
The relentless economic decline of the 1994 Ohio steel industry makes saving the plant almost structurally impossible.
Her aging body and physical exhaustion after decades of high-stakes labor organizing.
tactics: To corner - pin him down using his own corporate logic and past promises against him.
To shame - remind him of the specific sacrifices the town and his late father made to pay for his path out.
To interrogate - dissect his professional excuses piece by piece to expose his personal ambition.
To bargain - trade her remaining political influence and public silence in exchange for a delay on the mill's execution date.
To invoke - recall childhood memories of table-side union lessons to awaken his buried conscience.
backstory_beats: Enduring the devastation of the late-1970s Ohio mill shutdowns, which cemented her resolve to become a union organizer.
Spending late nights at the kitchen table training her young son on contract clauses, leverage points, and negotiation tactics.
Burying her husband after an industrial accident, fighting the company for years to secure his full pension benefits.
Celebrating her son's promotion into corporate management under the foolish belief he would be labor's insider ally.
given_circumstances: The setting is a dying industrial steel town in Ohio, 1994.
The steel plant is slated for permanent closure within days.
Her 58 years of life have been defined by local labor activism and community leadership.
Her son is the company executive who authorized the final closure order.

beats.beat: Mara confronts Eli about his whereabouts, moving from observation to accusation.
beats.subtext: I have been tracking your lies and I am waiting for you to crack.

beats.beat: Eli attempts to deflect blame by attacking Mara's need for control.
beats.turn: You always know everything before I say it.
beats.subtext: Your vigilance is suffocating and makes it impossible for me to be honest.

beats.beat: Mara traps Eli in a lie, forcing him into a corner.
beats.subtext: I have proof of your betrayal; stop pretending.

beats.beat: Eli resorts to a desperate, transparent falsehood.
beats.subtext: I am terrified of the finality of this moment and will say anything to delay the inevitable.

power_shifts.where: When Mara reveals she called the station
When Eli claims he was ending it

Mara.wants: To force Eli to admit he is leaving her.
Mara.hides: The depth of her devastation and fear of being alone.

Eli.wants: To escape the confrontation without taking responsibility for his departure.
Eli.hides: That he has already fully committed to leaving.

scene_notes.summary: This scene is a tactical battle over the disintegration of a relationship where one partner seeks closure through truth and the other seeks escape through cowardice.
